key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:26786
name: transform_object_for_sorting
description: Scales a 3x3 transform matrix down to a safe range, multiplies it by the input vector, and calls the same routine for the remaining steps. Exits early when the computed magnitude falls outside the bounds.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:267D2
name: record_nearest_object_depth
description: Computes a scaled depth from the transform matrix and vector, then stores the object in the nearest-depth record when its depth is smaller than the stored value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:26896
name: record_object_candidate_depth
description: Shifts the transform values by a scale factor, multiplies them by the matrix, and keeps the candidate in the depth record only if its depth is closer than the stored one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2692E
name: transform_matrix_and_record_depth
description: Multiplies two 3x3 matrix-vector products into six output words, then tests the result against the stored nearest depth and records the object when it is closer.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:26A58
name: walk_packed_draw_commands
description: Walks a packed command byte list. For each object command it tests a bit mask, reflects coordinates by flag bits, indexes a rotation table, and dispatches the vertex command handlers.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:26A92
name: enter_draw_command_loop
description: Checks the high bit of the command byte and either jumps into the packed command loop or falls through to the object record handler. Copies the second command byte into the object state.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:26A9C
name: dispatch_masked_object_command
description: Tests one bit of the mask chosen by the command index. When the bit is set, it runs the object record handler, which rotates the record by its flag bits and stores the transformed values in the scratch table.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:26AD2
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: A single-instruction routine with no operations, called by two other routines. It has no behaviour beyond returning.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:26AD4
name: scan_packed_draw_commands
description: Clamps a counter from the scratch state, then walks the packed draw command list, testing mask bits and dispatching object records.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:26AFC
name: scan_draw_commands_with_offset
description: Walks the packed draw command list after clamping a counter to a minimum of one. Tests mask bits and dispatches object records and the depth record update.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:26B22
name: transform_flagged_object_record
description: Reads an object record, offsets its position by the level shift, negates the coordinates selected by the flag bits, rotates six words through an index table, and passes them to two unnamed routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:26BCE
name: forward_to_unnamed_routine
description: Decompiled pseudo-code was unavailable, so this entry is described from its facts alone: 13 instructions, one caller and one called routine. Its specific behaviour is not recovered.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:26BF4
name: coordinate_four_unnamed_routine_calls
description: Decompiled pseudo-code was unavailable, so this entry is described from its facts alone: 41 instructions, two callers and four called routines. Its specific behaviour is not recovered.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:26C76
name: sequence_three_unnamed_routine_calls
description: Decompiled pseudo-code was unavailable, so this entry is described from its facts alone: 6 instructions, one caller and three called routines. Its specific behaviour is not recovered.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:26C8A
name: branch_three_unnamed_routine_calls
description: Decompiled pseudo-code was unavailable, so this entry is described from its facts alone: 7 instructions, one caller and three called routines. Its specific behaviour is not recovered.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:26CA0
name: scan_range_entries_for_match
description: Reads entries from a byte stream and compares each value against two bounds. A value in range stores three words of state, and the routine then skips to the zero terminator.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:26CC8
name: filter_entries_within_bounds
description: Loops over byte-stream entries and keeps the state words of each value that lies between two bounds. It skips to the zero terminator once the loop ends.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:26CE0
name: scan_entries_then_store_state
description: Reads byte-stream entries, compares each against bounds, and stores three words of state for a value in range. It then skips to the zero terminator.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:26D02
name: store_entries_while_in_bounds
description: Loops over entries while the value stays at or above a lower bound, stores three words of state when it is at or below an upper bound, and stops on a negative value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:26D18
name: divide_offset_dot_product_flagged
description: Computes a dot product of an offset from an origin with a stored vector, with signs chosen by flag bits, and divides it by a second dot product. It returns the quotient and remainder packed into one value, or a saturated value when the divisor is zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:26D4E
name: divide_offset_dot_product
description: Computes the dot product of an offset from an origin with a stored vector and divides it by a second dot product. It returns the quotient and remainder packed into one value, or a saturated value when the divisor is zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:26D92
name: scale_and_divide_offset_dot
description: Optionally shifts three coordinate words left, then computes an offset dot product with a stored vector and divides it by a second dot product. It returns a packed quotient and remainder, or a saturated value when the divisor is zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:26DD0
name: compute_xor_sign_mask
description: XORs one register word with the upper word of another input, then forms a 32-bit result from the sign of that word combined with a fixed mask constant. It is a small arithmetic unnamed routine with no memory access.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:26DDE
name: normalise_vector_operands
description: Stores six operand words in the scratch area, then shifts the operands until they fit a common range. It runs a bit-serial loop on the shifted values and calls one unnamed routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:26E3E
name: normalise_operands_and_multiply
description: Stores operand words after bit-serial shifts that align them to a common scale, then forms signed products of the first three coordinate values with the stored vector. It calls one unnamed routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:26E78
name: compute_scaled_vector_dot_sums
description: Aligns three coordinate words by a shift count with a bit-serial loop, then forms signed products with the stored vector components and sums them. It calls three unnamed routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:26FFA
name: store_closer_candidate_record
description: Scales an input value by a stored shift count and compares it with the stored best value. When it is closer, it copies the current state words and the candidate values into the record and calls one unnamed routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2700E
name: store_candidate_if_nearer
description: Shifts an input value by a count and, when the record is empty or the value is smaller than the stored one, copies the state words and candidate value into the record. It calls one unnamed routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:27034
name: store_candidate_record_unconditionally
description: Scales an input value by a shift count and writes it into the record with the state words and candidate values. It does not compare against the stored value first.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2708E
name: copy_eight_words_from_pointer
description: Waits until a flag word clears, then copies eight words from the source pointer into a state block and clears a status byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:270AC
name: call_then_copy_global_block
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then copies eight words from fixed global locations into the state block, sets a constant word, and sets the status byte to non-zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:270B2
name: copy_global_block_and_flag
description: Copies eight words from fixed global locations into the state block, sets a constant word, and sets the status byte to non-zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:270D2
name: wait_for_flags_clear
description: Busy-waits until a short flag word in the state block is zero, then busy-waits until a long global flag is zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:270E2
name: copy_large_word_block
description: Copies 800 blocks of ten words from one buffer pointer to another, then returns two input registers combined into one 64-bit value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2710C
name: copy_strided_buffer_ranges
description: Loops 32 times, copying groups of ten words from fixed offsets in the source buffer to the same offsets in the destination. Four separate offset ranges are copied on each pass.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:27160
name: store_eight_registers_to_state
description: Sets a status byte to non-zero and stores eight register values into consecutive state words.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2716E
name: reset_and_wait_for_flag
description: Clears a status byte, waits for a flag word to clear, writes a constant word and clears a second byte. It then calls one unnamed routine and waits for the flag again.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:27178
name: store_word_into_state
description: Stores the low input word into two state words.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:27182
name: swap_buffer_pointers
description: Copies eight 32-bit values from one state block to a second, then swaps two global buffer pointers and updates a global toggle byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:271CA
name: copy_first_pointer_to_slot
description: Copies the first global buffer pointer into a second global pointer slot.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:271D6
name: copy_second_pointer_to_slot
description: Copies the second global buffer pointer into the shared pointer slot.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:271E2
name: halt_in_infinite_loop
description: Loops forever with no operations. It is a terminal halt and touches no data or hardware.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:271FC
name: wait_then_set_counter_one
description: Busy-waits while a global counter is positive, then sets that counter to one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2720E
name: wait_then_set_counter_two
description: Busy-waits while a global counter is positive, then sets that counter to two.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:27320
name: read_pending_state_byte
description: Reads and clears a pending state byte. A negative value is returned with the next state byte, otherwise a byte is looked up in a global table and combined with the sign byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:27348
name: take_pending_state_byte
description: Clears the pending flag byte and returns the stored byte that was waiting.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:27352
name: store_pending_state_byte
description: Stores the low input byte as pending and sets the pending flag to non-zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2735E
name: read_pending_table_entry
description: Reads a state byte. A negative value is returned directly. Otherwise the state is cleared and a byte is returned from a global table indexed by that value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2736C
name: clear_state_byte_flag
description: Clears one state flag byte to zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:27422
name: setup_graphics_interrupts
description: Clears 32 longwords of state, opens the graphics library through the exec base, and stores the library pointers. It writes display, copper, DMA and interrupt enable registers, where bit 15 set enables and cleared disables the bits written.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:27584
name: wait_then_call_handlers
description: Waits until a short state flag clears, sets a global value, then calls two library routines through function pointers. It also writes the interrupt enable register.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:275B8
name: invoke_interrupt_handler
description: Calls a handler from a state pointer, writes two interrupt-control values, and calls one library routine through an exec vector. The interrupt enable write sets the listed bits when bit 15 is set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:275EE
name: shut_down_graphics_interrupts
description: Disables DMA and interrupt bits, removes the interrupt server, restores the interrupt vector and closes the graphics library. It reverses the setup routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:27666
name: copy_palette_at_raster_line
description: Polls a raster position value until it passes a threshold, then copies eight words of palette values to the colour registers. It writes the interrupt enable register with bit 15 set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:276AA
name: update_frame_counters_and_copper
description: Applies a pending state update when a flag is set and copies global values into the blitter and colour registers. It advances counters and timers, clears flags, and calls four routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:277BE
name: advance_blit_position_counter
description: Decrements a step counter. While it is non-zero, it selects a blitter control value, shifts a mask right, advances a 32-bit pointer by a fixed step, and writes the interrupt enable register.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:277F0
name: advance_blit_pointer_step
description: Shifts a mask word right, advances a 32-bit pointer by a fixed step, and writes blitter control and interrupt enable registers.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:27826
name: clear_flag_and_enable_interrupt
description: Clears a state word and writes the interrupt enable register with bit 15 set, which enables the interrupt bit written.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:27864
name: open_input_device
description: Stores two values, then opens the input device through the exec library. When the open succeeds it sets the request command to nine and sends the request with DoIO.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:278BC
name: close_input_device
description: When an input request exists, sets its command to ten, sends it with DoIO and closes the device. It then resets the object flags of the request.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2790A
name: update_input_button_state
description: Reads a flag bit from an input event record and stores its negation in a global table entry. It then records the new state bytes for the next event.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2794A
name: clear_input_record_fields
description: Clears one word and three bytes of an input record through the address register.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:279BE
name: allocate_message_port
description: Allocates a signal bit for the current task and then a message port structure. It initialises the port fields, adds the port with AddPort or sets up an empty list, and frees the signal if the allocation fails.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:27A42
name: free_message_port
description: Calls a cleanup routine when one is set, marks two status bytes as all ones, then removes the port and frees its memory and signal bit.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:27A86
name: reset_cursor_state_words
description: Sets two state words to zero and 512.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:27A8C
name: store_cursor_position_words
description: Stores two input words into the cursor position state words.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:27A96
name: read_cursor_position_pair
description: Returns the two cursor position state words packed into one 64-bit result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:27AA4
name: read_low_two_state_bits
description: Returns the low two bits of a state byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:27AAE
name: update_cursor_position
description: Adds movement offsets to the cursor position and clamps it to the 320 by 200 screen. It writes the packed position to a hardware register, then tests a table of rectangular regions and records the matching region value and flag.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:27BDE
name: update_joystick_velocity_flags
description: Reduces two velocity words toward zero by 300 and applies 700-unit accelerations chosen by direction flag bits. It clamps the results to the signed 16-bit range and stores both velocities with a moving flag. The facts list joystick port and fire-button register reads.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:27CEE
name: set_state_word_all_ones
description: Sets one state word to all ones, which is negative one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:27D98
name: append_global_records_to_table
description: Sets a state word to negative one, finds the end of the record table, and copies five-word records from a global list into it. Each copied record is followed by a negative marker.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:27DA2
name: copy_input_records_to_table
description: Finds the end of the record table, then copies five-word records from the input pointer, writing a negative marker after each one. The copy stops at a negative record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:27DC6
name: remove_matching_table_record
description: Finds the first five-word record whose matching field equals the input value, then shifts the records after it back over it and keeps the negative terminator.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:27DEC
name: append_clamped_table_record
description: Finds the end of the record table and appends a record built from two input ranges offset by a value. It clamps the first pair at zero, writes a negative terminator, and returns the two inputs packed together.

description: When one structure has a flag set and the other does not, it projects a vector onto a second and returns two scaled sums. Otherwise it normalises a pair of values with a bit-serial shift count. Calls four routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:290A0

description: Takes a 64-bit value from a unnamed routine and adds two 16-bit fields from the input block, each shifted left by 16 and right by 6, to its two halves.

description: When one state byte differs from a second structure's byte and matches its neighbour, it subtracts two stored offsets from a unnamed routine's 64-bit result. Otherwise it returns the negated offsets. Calls two routines.

description: Reads two 32-bit values from a structure and returns them negated, packed into one 64-bit result.

description: Normalises a 64-bit vector and a scalar by a shift chosen from their magnitudes, stores the scaled values and shift count in the structure, and updates a countdown byte. Calls two routines.

description: Normalises a 64-bit vector and a scalar by a shift count, stores the values in the structure, and when a threshold check passes, updates position fields and flag bytes. Calls two routines.

description: Normalises the inputs by a shift, stores the scaled values, and when a threshold check passes adds the update values into the position fields of two structures. Calls five routines.

description: When the structure's flag word is non-zero, adds the pending position deltas into its position fields and accumulates them into a second structure. It then clears the state words. Calls three routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:29568

description: Multiplies three stored components by a scale factor with sign handling, subtracts the stored positions from the results, and stores three values in the structure. Calls two routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:295F8

name: accumulate_position_offsets
description: Adds three input offsets to stored 16-bit counters and to the 64-bit position fields. The second and third sums are clamped to a limit, and the position fields are written only when no overflow occurs. Calls two routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:298B6
name: store_offsets_with_overflow_check
description: Adds an input offset into a 16-bit counter and writes a third value and two sums into the position fields when no overflow occurs. Calls one routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:298D0
name: clamp_and_add_value
description: Clamps an input to a minimum value, adds it to another input, and stores the sum with two other inputs in the structure when no overflow occurs.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:298E2
name: accumulate_clamped_position_deltas
description: Shifts three inputs right by a count, clamps each against stored limit values, and adds the results into three 32-bit accumulators when no overflow occurs. Calls two routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:298F8
name: clamp_and_accumulate_three
description: Clamps three inputs against limits, then adds them into three 32-bit accumulators in the structure when no overflow occurs. Calls one routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:29904
name: accumulate_clamped_second_pair
description: Clamps two inputs against limits and adds them, with an unclamped first input, into three 32-bit accumulators when no overflow occurs. Calls two routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:29910
name: accumulate_with_clamped_pair
description: Clamps two inputs against limits, then adds them with an unclamped input into three 32-bit accumulators when no overflow occurs. Calls one routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2991C
name: accumulate_clamped_third_value
description: Clamps the third input against a limit, then adds the first two inputs and the clamped value into three 32-bit accumulators when no overflow occurs. Calls two routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:29928
name: accumulate_clamped_third_pair
description: Clamps one input against a limit, then adds the first two inputs and the clamped value into three 32-bit accumulators when no overflow occurs. Calls one routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:29934
name: accumulate_three_inputs_checked
description: Adds three inputs into three 32-bit accumulators in the structure, only when no overflow occurs. Calls one routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:29950
name: normalise_and_scale_position_words
description: Normalises six 32-bit position words by a shift count and stores three of them in the scratch area. When a flag word is set, it computes a scaled value from the stored words by repeated multiplication and shifts. Calls three routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:299B6
name: accumulate_scaled_offsets_divided
description: Normalises three inputs and a scalar, computes a scale from a stored value by division, and adds the scaled offsets into the structure's accumulators. Calls two routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:29A62
name: accumulate_scaled_offsets
description: Scales three inputs by a factor derived from a stored vector and a shift count, then adds them to 32-bit accumulators and 16-bit counters in the structure. Calls one routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:29ABE
name: shift_and_accumulate
description: Right-shifts three inputs by a count taken from a register, then adds them into three 32-bit accumulators in the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:29ADE
name: add_entity_positions
description: Adds a second record of 64-bit position fields into the first, copies a state byte, and adds a unnamed routine's 64-bit result into the accumulators of the first structure. Calls two routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:29B20
name: subtract_entity_position
description: Copies a byte from a register into the structure, subtracts the second record's position fields from the first, and subtracts a unnamed routine's 64-bit result from the accumulators. Calls three routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:29B70
name: find_lowest_cost_entry
description: Scans a table of 114 entries, skipping those without a flag bit. It keeps the entry with the smallest scaled cost, then records its index and state byte. Calls one routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:29B78
name: find_lowest_cost_candidate
description: Computes a starting cost from a stored byte, then scans the table for the lowest-cost entry with the flag bit set. It updates the best candidate and its state byte. Calls seven routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:29C02
name: scan_entries_for_matching_state
description: Scans table entries whose state byte matches a value and keeps the one with the smallest scaled cost. When one is found, it copies its state and adds a unnamed routine's 64-bit result into the structure. Calls four routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:29C34
name: add_positions_with_result
description: Copies a state byte from the second structure, adds its position fields into the first, and adds a unnamed routine's 64-bit result into the accumulators. Calls one routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:29C3A
name: add_positions_after_unnamed_routine
description: Calls one routine, copies a state byte, adds the second structure's position fields into the first, and adds a unnamed routine's 64-bit result into the accumulators. Calls two routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:29C48
name: clear_flag_and_scan_table
description: Clears one flag bit in a global status byte. If that bit was set, it scans a 114-entry table backward for entries with another flag bit set, and for each match it clears a state byte and sets a 32-bit field to a fixed two-word pattern.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:29C7A
name: select_source_words_and_call
description: Chooses one of two sets of four words from the input block by a flag byte. It calls a routine with the chosen words, and calls another routine first when the flag is set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:29C92
name: copy_matrix_to_buffer
description: Copies eight words from the input block into the destination buffer, zeroes two longword fields and writes fixed values to two words. Calls two routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:29CCC
name: transform_object_matrix
description: Updates a cached three-by-three matrix from an object's basis, multiplies it by a stored vector, and writes the transformed basis vectors and a scaled value into a global structure. Calls three routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:29DB2
name: store_normalised_position_difference
description: Subtracts a stored 64-bit position from the input position, normalises the component differences by a shift, and stores them at structure offsets. It copies four longwords from a lookup table selected by a state byte. Calls three routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:29DBA
name: store_normalised_difference_scan
description: Follows linked records until a flag bit is set, then subtracts the stored position from the input, normalises the differences by a shift and stores them at structure offsets. It copies four longwords from a lookup table. Calls four routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:29E5A
name: load_table_into_buffer
description: Shifts a value right until it is below 16384, stores three input words at structure offsets, and copies four longwords from a lookup table selected by a state byte. Calls one routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:29EFA
name: process_object_flags_scan
description: Sets a status bit, then scans a table backward for entries with a flag bit set and processes each one through unnamed routines. When a state byte matches, it writes a fixed two-word pattern, and it sets a 200 counter field on the flagged entries. Calls seven routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:29FE8
name: resume_object_flags_scan
description: Continues the table scan used by the neighbouring routine. Matching entries get a fixed two-word pattern, and the other entries go through unnamed routines. Calls three routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A00E
name: resume_flagged_entry_scan
description: Writes a fixed two-word pattern to the entry, then continues the table scan over entries with a flag bit set. It calls unnamed routines for each match and for the flag handling. Calls one routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A018
name: scan_flagged_table_entries
description: Scans a 114-entry table backward for entries with a flag bit set and calls an unnamed routine for each one. It stores a word and calls another routine unless a counter byte is non-zero, in which case it decrements the counter. Calls three routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A046
name: process_object_flags
description: Stores a word parameter in a global, then scans a byte table backward. It skips entries whose bit is clear, calls an unnamed routine for each set entry, and repeats while a counter byte is zero, otherwise decrementing that counter. Calls two routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A062
name: transform_entry_by_flags
description: Selects one of two vectors from a record by a flag bit, negates the matrix rows when that bit is clear, and multiplies the vector by the rows. Calls two routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A09A
name: accumulate_scaled_transform_offset
description: Chooses one of two vectors from a record by a flag bit and negates the matrix rows in the flagged case. It multiplies the rows by the vector and adds the products, shifted right by 12 bits, into the record's position fields. Sets a counter field and calls one routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A14C
name: accumulate_direct_transform_offset
description: Selects one of two vectors by a state word and multiplies the matrix rows by it. It adds the products, shifted right by 12 bits, into the record's position fields, sets a counter field, and calls one routine. Calls two routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A1C4
name: clear_flag_byte_at_entry
description: Clears one flag byte of the entry record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A1CA
name: scan_table_for_clear_flags
description: Clears a word, then scans a 114-entry table backward. For each entry whose flag bit is clear, it calls two unnamed routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A1D2
name: iterate_and_call_handler
description: Scans a 114-entry byte table backward. For each entry whose flag bit is clear, it calls a unnamed routine and then calls a handler through a function pointer.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A1F6
name: check_bounds_and_call
description: Scans a byte table backward and skips entries whose flag bit is set. For entries with a clear flag, it calls an unnamed routine, then calls a handler only when two stored coordinates lie within screen-sized bounds.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A236
name: decrement_counter_and_dispatch
description: Scans a table backward for entries with bit 0 set and calls an unnamed routine for each one. It decrements a counter byte, and when the counter reaches zero it reloads it and calls a handler selected by an index byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A286
name: process_bit_two_flag
description: Clears a flag bit in a global byte, then scans a table backward for entries with bit 1 set. For each one it calls an unnamed routine and calls a handler selected by an index byte when that index is non-zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A2C8
name: write_byte_to_indirect
description: Writes one byte from the input into a location calculated from a stored base pointer and an offset byte taken from the record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A2DC
name: store_record_in_flagged_slot
description: Searches a table backward for a slot whose flag bit is set. When one is found with a non-zero index, it writes the input byte there, adjusts a counter for the flag, and copies a long record from the input block into the slot. Calls one routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A2FC
name: store_record_in_searched_slot
description: Searches the table downward for a slot with a clear flag bit, returning the default input when none qualifies. Otherwise it writes the input byte, adjusts a counter when the flag is set, and copies a long record into the slot. Calls two routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A324
name: store_record_at_index
description: Writes the input byte at the given index in the state block when the index is non-zero, adjusts a counter for the flag bit, and copies a long record from the input block into the slot. Calls two routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A330
name: copy_entity_record_block
description: Copies an entity record word by word from the source pointer to the destination pointer, field by field, and skips the copy when both pointers are equal.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A4F2
name: store_record_in_free_slot
description: Searches for a slot with a zero state byte, falling back to a slot with the flag bit set. It writes the input byte and copies a long record into the chosen slot, or returns the default input when no slot qualifies. Calls two routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A512
name: store_record_in_zero_slot
description: Searches for a zero state byte and, failing that, for a slot with the flag bit set. It writes the input byte and copies a long record into the chosen slot, or returns the default input when none qualifies. Calls two routines.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A548
name: return_without_action
description: Contains no operations and returns immediately, as its empty pseudo-code body shows.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A556
name: return_without_action
description: Contains no operations and returns immediately. The routine is called from a handler table.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A564
name: return_without_action
description: Contains four instructions with no observable work and falls through to a return. Five routines call it.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A56E
name: return_without_action
description: Contains a single return instruction and no other work. Seven routines call it.
